title: AS2 compiler: String.fromCharCode() not special-cased — should emit ActionMBStringExtract or ActionChr
description: In Flash AS2/AVM1, String.fromCharCode(n) converts a character code to a string. The AS2 compiler does not special-case this call — it falls through to generic ActionCallFunction (0x3D). The correct AVM1 encoding: String.fromCharCode(n) → push n, ActionMBChr (0x63) for multibyte or ActionChr (0x33) for single-byte. Flash Professional emits ActionMBChr (0x63). Fix in compiler.ts: detect CallExpression with callee MemberExpression(Identifier('String'), 'fromCharCode') and 1 argument — compile the argument then emit opcode 0x63 (ActionMBChr).
